edits.new: No credential and no personal name appears in the request, the row, the workflow input, the record or the logs. The two operations of 12.1 are checked by the platform guard library against the rights and scope data of rwb-access (DP-08); the name of the rwb-access authorise check is Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S2-E3001-APP-6).

edits.old: `treatment` is the only table this story creates, from DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033 as TSD S2 T3.1 lists them.
edits.new: `treatment` is the only table this story creates, from DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033 as TSD S2 T3.1 lists them. The four entity groups of rwb-treatment, as product requirements, are treatments, contracts, settlement and deed-in-lieu agreements, and plan timers (Architecture v5 slides 18, 30 and 41); no physical table name is fixed here, and the key fields of contracts, agreements and plan timers are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1698). The only field catalog in the FSD holds treatment.case_id, decision_log_id, treatment_type, proposed_by, proposed_at, offer_amount, haircut_amount and installments (FSD S2 A2.2.3.2); this service holds the contract, the agreement, the plan timer and the booking reference, and their physical field list stays open until the data architect writes it with the DB story (GAP-1712).
